name: one-erp
description: OneERP 是面向制造与供应链企业的 AI Native ERP，聚焦真实库存、财务可靠性、权限治理和单机可恢复生产部署。
author: OneERP Team

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm --prefix apps/api run test -- --passWithNoTests && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.validate: node scripts/prisma-static-check.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.audit:security: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix apps/api audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix apps/web audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix apps/mobile audit --audit-level=high
scripts.risk:preflight: npm run risk:audit && npm run enum:dirty-sql
scripts.risk:preflight:db: npm run risk:preflight && npm run enum:dirty-report
